name: dsh-you-should-know
description: Quiet, human-only second-opinion reviewer for DeepSeek Harness: a separately configured reviewer model (DeepSeek by default, any registered provider and model by config) watches completed root-agent turns and, only when something important was missed, shows a dismissible card above the composer. It never injects or steers the primary agent.
